text: 1. A photocopy of passportfront page. The expiry date of the passport should be after March 1, 2026.2. Senior high school diploma. Those who provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate at application MUST provide senior high school diploma no later than registration.3. Academic transcripts for all the courses in senior high school.4. Language proficiency certificates.Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must provide the photocopy of HSK certificate.Applicants for English-taught programs must provide grade report of TOEFL or IELTS test, or other proof which can reflect the applicants’ English proficiency. (Not required for English native speakers)5. Personal statement, in Chinese or English, should include study experience, reasons for application, personal strengths. No less than 800 words.6. Two recommendation letters from high school teachers. (Teachers’ signature, contact phone number and email address must be put on the letter.)7. Award-winning Certificates related to academic courses during senior high school period. (If applicable)8. Applicants who have given up their original Chinese citizenship and become foreign citizens shall provide:8.1Documents certifying the cancellation of Chinese citizenship,8.2Documents certifying the cancellation of Chinese household registration,8.3 Documents certifying the acquirement of foreign citizenship,8.4Exit and Entry Record on passport, from April 30, 2021 to April 30, 2025,8.5 Self-Statement Form of Nationality Status and Nationality Confirmation and Guarantee Letter (Download).9. Applicants who have acquired foreign citizenship automatically at the time of birth in a foreign country, whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one of the parents was a Chinese citizen shall provide:9.1Documents certifying acquiring foreign citizenship at the time of birth,9.2Documents certifying parent’s (with Chinese citizenship) permanent residence in foreign country before the birth of the applicant,9.3 Exit and Entry Record on passport, from April 30, 2021 to April 30, 2025,9.4 Self-Statement Form of Nationality Status and Nationality Confirmation and Guarantee Letter (Download).10. Applicants under the age of 18 (by September 1st, 2025) should submit Letter of Guardian Guarantee（Download）and the guardian must be an adult living in Chinese mainland.11. Commitments for Zhejiang University Undergraduate Application (Download). The PDF version of the Commitments must be clearly and completely filled out and hand-signed. Applications without the Commitments will not be accepted.
